notes.title: Traduction, Menu (bêta)
notes.content:
A main menu and the game available in English!

I released this update to fix a lot of issues and also to make the game accessible to English.

A big update will come to add an option menu, new objects, ect

notes.title: Traduction et un menu
notes.content:
In the next update, discover a beautiful menu and the game available in English!
Go to Discord ([url=https://discord.gg/Q88A8juU7m]https://discord.gg/Q88A8juU7m[/url]) to see screenshots!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.content:
- Changed the guide at startup
- Bug fix
- Change of software version (more stable)

notes.title: Patch 0.11
notes.content:
Patch 0.11
- The game remains active even if the window is minimized
- A text is displayed with the layer number when a layer has been selected ("c" key)
- Display on which layer is an object (“h” key), function being tested!
- Setting up a menu, "escape" key
- Resolution and optimization
